import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
import pickle
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from transformers import AutoConfig, AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# ============================================================
# FEATURE ENGINEERING
# ============================================================
def extract_text_features(df, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    features["char_count"] = df["text"].str.len()
    features["word_count"] = df["text"].str.split().str.len()
    features["avg_word_length"] = features["char_count"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["sentence_count"] = df["text"].str.count("[.!?]") + 1
    features["avg_sentence_length"] = features["word_count"] / (
        features["sentence_count"] + 1
    )
    features["exclamation_count"] = df["text"].str.count("!")
    features["question_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\?")
    features["comma_count"] = df["text"].str.count(",")
    features["semicolon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(";")
    features["colon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(":")
    features["dash_count"] = df["text"].str.count("—|-")
    features["quote_count"] = df["text"].str.count('"')
    features["paren_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"[()]")
    features["punctuation_ratio"] = (
        features["exclamation_count"]
        + features["question_count"]
        + features["comma_count"]
        + features["semicolon_count"]
        + features["colon_count"]
        + features["dash_count"]
    ) / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["capital_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z][a-z]*\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1
    )
    features["all_caps_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1
    )
    features["special_char_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"[^a-zA-Z\s]")
    features["numeric_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\d+")
    features["i_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ii]\b")
    features["we_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]e\b")
    features["you_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Yy]ou\b")
    features["he_she_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Hh]e\b|\b[Ss]he\b")
    features["it_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ii]t\b")
    features["the_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Tt]he\b")
    features["and_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Aa]nd\b")
    features["but_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Bb]ut\b")
    features["for_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ff]or\b")
    features["with_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]ith\b")
    features["upon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Uu]pon\b")
    features["which_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]hich\b")
    features["that_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Tt]hat\b")
    features["not_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Nn]ot\b")
    features["was_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]as\b")
    features["had_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Hh]ad\b")
    features["were_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]ere\b")
    for col in [
        "the_count",
        "and_count",
        "but_count",
        "for_count",
        "with_count",
        "upon_count",
        "which_count",
        "that_count",
        "not_count",
        "was_count",
        "had_count",
        "were_count",
    ]:
        features[f"{col}_density"] = features[col] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["ellipsis_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\.\.\.|…")
    features["em_dash_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"—|--")
    features["unique_word_ratio"] = df["text"].apply(
        lambda x: len(set(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x).lower())))
        / max(len(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x))), 1)
    )
    stop_words = [
        "the",
        "a",
        "an",
        "and",
        "or",
        "but",
        "in",
        "on",
        "at",
        "to",
        "for",
        "of",
        "with",
        "by",
        "from",
        "as",
        "was",
        "were",
        "had",
        "not",
        "be",
        "been",
        "being",
        "have",
        "has",
        "had",
        "do",
        "does",
        "did",
        "will",
        "would",
        "can",
        "could",
        "may",
        "might",
        "shall",
        "should",
        "must",
        "that",
        "which",
        "who",
        "whom",
        "this",
        "that",
        "these",
        "those",
        "i",
        "you",
        "he",
        "she",
        "it",
        "we",
        "they",
        "me",
        "him",
        "her",
        "us",
        "them",
        "my",
        "your",
        "his",
        "her",
        "its",
        "our",
        "their",
        "mine",
        "yours",
        "his",
        "hers",
        "its",
        "ours",
        "theirs",
    ]
    features["stop_word_ratio"] = df["text"].apply(
        lambda x: sum(
            1 for w in re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x).lower()) if w in stop_words
        )
        / max(len(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x))), 1)
    )
    all_words = df["text"].apply(lambda x: re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x)))
    features["short_word_ratio"] = all_words.apply(
        lambda words: sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 3) / max(len(words), 1)
    )
    features["medium_word_ratio"] = all_words.apply(
        lambda words: sum(1 for w in words if 4 <= len(w) <= 7) / max(len(words), 1)
    )
    features["long_word_ratio"] = all_words.apply(
        lambda words: sum(1 for w in words if len(w) >= 8) / max(len(words), 1)
    )
    return features


le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_full = le.fit_transform(train_df["author"])

# ============================================================
# TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT (FIRST - to avoid data leakage)
# ============================================================
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))
print(f"\nTrain size: {len(train_idx)}, Val size: {len(val_idx)}")

train_df_split = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_df_split = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
y_train = y_full[train_idx]
y_val = y_full[val_idx]

print("Extracting text features on train split only...")
train_features = extract_text_features(train_df_split, is_train=True)
val_features = extract_text_features(val_df_split, is_train=False)
test_features = extract_text_features(test_df, is_train=False)
print(f"Train features shape: {train_features.shape}")

print("Computing TF-IDF features (fit on train split only)...")
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 5),
    max_features=5000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.8,
)
char_tfidf_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df_split["text"])
char_tfidf_val = char_vectorizer.transform(val_df_split["text"])
char_tfidf_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])

word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=3000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.8,
    stop_words="english",
)
word_tfidf_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df_split["text"])
word_tfidf_val = word_vectorizer.transform(val_df_split["text"])
word_tfidf_test = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])

feature_cols = train_features.columns
scaler = StandardScaler()
train_features_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(train_features)
val_features_scaled = scaler.transform(val_features)
test_features_scaled = scaler.transform(test_features)
train_features_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    train_features_scaled, columns=feature_cols, index=train_features.index
)
val_features_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    val_features_scaled, columns=feature_cols, index=val_features.index
)
test_features_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    test_features_scaled, columns=feature_cols, index=test_features.index
)

train_dense_sparse = csr_matrix(train_features_scaled.values)
val_dense_sparse = csr_matrix(val_features_scaled.values)
test_dense_sparse = csr_matrix(test_features_scaled.values)
X_train = hstack([train_dense_sparse, char_tfidf_train, word_tfidf_train])
X_val = hstack([val_dense_sparse, char_tfidf_val, word_tfidf_val])
X_test = hstack([test_dense_sparse, char_tfidf_test, word_tfidf_test])
print(f"Combined train shape: {X_train.shape}")

# ============================================================
# MODEL DESIGN - DeBERTa-v3-large with gated fusion, char-cnn, stylo
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")


class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, hidden_size, char_embed_dim=50, kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4, 5], num_filters=32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(256, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(char_embed_dim, num_filters, k, padding=k // 2)
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.proj = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        x = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(x)
            conv_out = F.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        x = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        return self.proj(x)


class StylometricEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=34, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class GatedFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_streams=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * num_streams, num_streams), nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        self.stream_proj = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size) for _ in range(num_streams)]
        )

    def forward(self, *streams):
        concat = torch.cat(streams, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat)
        projected = [self.stream_proj[i](s) for i, s in enumerate(streams)]
        fused = torch.stack(projected, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = gate_weights.unsqueeze(1)
        output = (fused * gate_weights).sum(dim=-1)
        return output


class SpookyAuthorModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large", config=config
        )
        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.char_cnn = CharCNN(hidden_size)
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim, output_dim=hidden_size
        )
        self.fusion = GatedFusion(hidden_size, num_streams=3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.classifier.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.classifier.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, char_ids=None, stylo_features=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-3:]
        weighted_hidden = sum(h * (0.5**i) for i, h in enumerate(hidden_states))
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_embeddings = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)
        debert_rep = sum_embeddings / sum_mask
        debert_rep = self.dropout(debert_rep)
        if char_ids is not None:
            char_rep = self.char_cnn(char_ids)
            char_rep = self.dropout(char_rep)
        else:
            char_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        if stylo_features is not None:
            stylo_rep = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
            stylo_rep = self.dropout(stylo_rep)
        else:
            stylo_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        fused = self.fusion(debert_rep, char_rep, stylo_rep)
        fused = self.dropout(fused)
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorModel(
    num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
).to(device)
print(f"Total parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")
print(
    f"Trainable parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad):,}"
)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

backbone_unfrozen_params = []
for layer in model.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
    for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
        if param.requires_grad:
            if "bias" in name or "LayerNorm" in name or "layernorm" in name:
                backbone_unfrozen_params.append({"params": param, "weight_decay": 0.0})
            else:
                backbone_unfrozen_params.append({"params": param, "weight_decay": 0.01})
head_params = []
for module in [model.char_cnn, model.stylo_encoder, model.fusion, model.classifier]:
    for name, param in module.named_parameters():
        if "bias" in name or "norm" in name.lower():
            head_params.append({"params": param, "weight_decay": 0.0})
        else:
            head_params.append({"params": param, "weight_decay": 0.01})

optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {"params": backbone_unfrozen_params, "lr": 2e-5},
        {"params": head_params, "lr": 5e-5},
    ],
    betas=(0.9, 0.98),
    eps=1e-8,
)

# ============================================================
# DATASET AND DATALOADER
# ============================================================
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


train_texts = train_df["text"].values
train_labels = np.array(
    [{"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}[a] for a in train_df["author"].values]
)
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

train_texts_final = train_texts[train_idx]
train_labels_final = train_labels[train_idx]
val_texts_final = train_texts[val_idx]
val_labels_final = train_labels[val_idx]

batch_size = 16
max_length = 512

train_dataset = SpookyDataset(
    train_texts_final, train_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length
)
val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts_final, val_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length)
test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 30
patience = 5
best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)

total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=total_steps // 2, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)
initial_lrs = [group["lr"] for group in optimizer.param_groups]
stylometric_dim = 34

# Prepare stylometric features for training/val (use X_train which has all features)
# We need to extract the first 34 columns from X_train for stylo features
# X_train is hstack of [train_dense_sparse (34 cols), char_tfidf, word_tfidf]
stylo_train_full = (
    X_train[train_idx, :34].toarray()
    if X_train.shape[1] >= 34
    else np.zeros((len(train_idx), stylometric_dim))
)
stylo_val_full = (
    X_train[val_idx, :34].toarray()
    if X_train.shape[1] >= 34
    else np.zeros((len(val_idx), stylometric_dim))
)
stylo_test_full = (
    X_test[:, :34].toarray()
    if X_test.shape[1] >= 34
    else np.zeros((len(test_texts), stylometric_dim))
)

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0
    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            # Use stylometric features for this batch
            start_idx = batch_idx * batch_size
            end_idx = min(start_idx + batch_size, len(stylo_train_full))
            if start_idx < end_idx:
                stylo_batch = torch.tensor(
                    stylo_train_full[start_idx:end_idx], dtype=torch.float
                ).to(device)
                # Pad or truncate if batch size mismatch
                if stylo_batch.shape[0] < input_ids.shape[0]:
                    pad = torch.zeros(
                        input_ids.shape[0] - stylo_batch.shape[0], stylometric_dim
                    ).to(device)
                    stylo_batch = torch.cat([stylo_batch, pad], dim=0)
            else:
                stylo_batch = torch.zeros(input_ids.shape[0], stylometric_dim).to(
                    device
                )
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, stylo_features=stylo_batch)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()
        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx
        if current_step < warmup_steps:
            warmup_factor = current_step / max(1, warmup_steps)
            for param_group in optimizer.param_groups:
                param_group["lr"] = initial_lrs[0] * warmup_factor
        else:
            scheduler.step(epoch + current_step / len(train_loader))
        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(val_loader):
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
            start_idx = batch_idx * batch_size
            end_idx = min(start_idx + batch_size, len(stylo_val_full))
            if start_idx < end_idx:
                stylo_batch = torch.tensor(
                    stylo_val_full[start_idx:end_idx], dtype=torch.float
                ).to(device)
                if stylo_batch.shape[0] < input_ids.shape[0]:
                    pad = torch.zeros(
                        input_ids.shape[0] - stylo_batch.shape[0], stylometric_dim
                    ).to(device)
                    stylo_batch = torch.cat([stylo_batch, pad], dim=0)
            else:
                stylo_batch = torch.zeros(input_ids.shape[0], stylometric_dim).to(
                    device
                )
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, stylo_features=stylo_batch)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state
        cls_pool = hidden_states[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.head(cls_pool)
        return logits

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

num_epochs = 30

# Initialize scheduler
scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=total_steps // 2, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)

for epoch in range(num_epochs):

    num_train_batches = 0

        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        # Apply scheduler step per batch
        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx
        if current_step < warmup_steps:
            warmup_factor = current_step / max(1, warmup_steps)
            for param_group in optimizer.param_groups:
                param_group["lr"] = initial_lrs[0] * warmup_factor
        else:

    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):

        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,

        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:

    def __len__(self):

train_labels_final = train_labels_orig[train_indices]

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP

num_epochs = 30
patience = 5
best_val_score = float("inf")

from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts
import math

        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)

        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)

        # Apply scheduler step per batch

        if current_step < warmup_steps:

            for param_group in optimizer.param_groups:

        else:

def extract_text_features(df, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    features["char_count"] = df["text"].str.len()
    features["word_count"] = df["text"].str.split().str.len()
    features["avg_word_length"] = features["char_count"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["sentence_count"] = df["text"].str.count("[.!?]") + 1
    features["avg_sentence_length"] = features["word_count"] / (
        features["sentence_count"] + 1
    )
    features["exclamation_count"] = df["text"].str.count("!")
    features["question_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\?")
    features["comma_count"] = df["text"].str.count(",")
    features["semicolon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(";")
    features["colon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(":")
    features["dash_count"] = df["text"].str.count("—|-")
    features["quote_count"] = df["text"].str.count('"')
    features["paren_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"[()]")
    features["punctuation_ratio"] = (
        features["exclamation_count"]
        + features["question_count"]
        + features["comma_count"]
        + features["semicolon_count"]
        + features["colon_count"]
        + features["dash_count"]
    ) / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["capital_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z][a-z]*\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1
    )
    features["all_caps_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1

class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, hidden_size, char_embed_dim=50, kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4, 5], num_filters=32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(256, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(char_embed_dim, num_filters, k, padding=k // 2)
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.proj = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        x = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(x)
            conv_out = F.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        x = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        return self.proj(x)


class StylometricEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=34, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class GatedFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_streams=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * num_streams, num_streams), nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        self.stream_proj = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size) for _ in range(num_streams)]
        )

    def forward(self, *streams):
        concat = torch.cat(streams, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat)
        projected = [self.stream_proj[i](s) for i, s in enumerate(streams)]
        fused = torch.stack(projected, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = gate_weights.unsqueeze(1)
        output = (fused * gate_weights).sum(dim=-1)
        return output


class SpookyAuthorModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large", config=config
        )
        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.char_cnn = CharCNN(hidden_size)
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim, output_dim=hidden_size
        )
        self.fusion = GatedFusion(hidden_size, num_streams=3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.classifier.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.classifier.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, char_ids=None, stylo_features=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-3:]
        weighted_hidden = sum(h * (0.5**i) for i, h in enumerate(hidden_states))
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_embeddings = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)
        debert_rep = sum_embeddings / sum_mask
        debert_rep = self.dropout(debert_rep)
        if char_ids is not None:
            char_rep = self.char_cnn(char_ids)
            char_rep = self.dropout(char_rep)
        else:
            char_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        if stylo_features is not None:
            stylo_rep = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
            stylo_rep = self.dropout(stylo_rep)
        else:
            stylo_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        fused = self.fusion(debert_rep, char_rep, stylo_rep)
        fused = self.dropout(fused)
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0
    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            # Use stylometric features for this batch
            start_idx = batch_idx * batch_size
            end_idx = min(start_idx + batch_size, len(stylo_train_full))
            if start_idx < end_idx:
                stylo_batch = torch.tensor(
                    stylo_train_full[start_idx:end_idx], dtype=torch.float
                ).to(device)
                # Pad or truncate if batch size mismatch
                if stylo_batch.shape[0] < input_ids.shape[0]:
                    pad = torch.zeros(
                        input_ids.shape[0] - stylo_batch.shape[0], stylometric_dim
                    ).to(device)
                    stylo_batch = torch.cat([stylo_batch, pad], dim=0)
            else:
                stylo_batch = torch.zeros(input_ids.shape[0], stylometric_dim).to(
                    device
                )
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, stylo_features=stylo_batch)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()
        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx
        if current_step < warmup_steps:
            warmup_factor = current_step / max(1, warmup_steps)
            for param_group in optimizer.param_groups:
                param_group["lr"] = initial_lrs[0] * warmup_factor
        else:
            scheduler.step(epoch + current_step / len(train_loader))
        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []

            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)

            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            end_idx = min(start_idx + batch_size, len(stylo_val_full))
            if start_idx < end_idx:
                stylo_batch = torch.tensor(
                    stylo_val_full[start_idx:end_idx], dtype=torch.float
                ).to(device)
                if stylo_batch.shape[0] < input_ids.shape[0]:
                    pad = torch.zeros(
                        input_ids.shape[0] - stylo_batch.shape[0], stylometric_dim
                    ).to(device)
                    stylo_batch = torch.cat([stylo_batch, pad], dim=0)
            else:
                stylo_batch = torch.zeros(input_ids.shape[0], stylometric_dim).to(
                    device
                )
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, stylo_features=stylo_batch)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches

class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, hidden_size, char_embed_dim=50, kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4, 5], num_filters=32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(256, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(char_embed_dim, num_filters, k, padding=k // 2)
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.proj = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        x = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(x)
            conv_out = F.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        x = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        return self.proj(x)


class StylometricEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=34, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class GatedFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_streams=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * num_streams, num_streams), nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        self.stream_proj = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size) for _ in range(num_streams)]
        )

    def forward(self, *streams):
        concat = torch.cat(streams, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat)
        projected = [self.stream_proj[i](s) for i, s in enumerate(streams)]
        fused = torch.stack(projected, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = gate_weights.unsqueeze(1)
        output = (fused * gate_weights).sum(dim=-1)
        return output


class SpookyAuthorModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large", config=config
        )
        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.char_cnn = CharCNN(hidden_size)
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim, output_dim=hidden_size
        )
        self.fusion = GatedFusion(hidden_size, num_streams=3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.classifier.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.classifier.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, char_ids=None, stylo_features=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-3:]
        weighted_hidden = sum(h * (0.5**i) for i, h in enumerate(hidden_states))
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_embeddings = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)
        debert_rep = sum_embeddings / sum_mask
        debert_rep = self.dropout(debert_rep)
        if char_ids is not None:
            char_rep = self.char_cnn(char_ids)
            char_rep = self.dropout(char_rep)
        else:
            char_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        if stylo_features is not None:
            stylo_rep = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
            stylo_rep = self.dropout(stylo_rep)
        else:
            stylo_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        fused = self.fusion(debert_rep, char_rep, stylo_rep)
        fused = self.dropout(fused)
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorModel(

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):

import pandas as pd

def extract_text_features(df, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    features["char_count"] = df["text"].str.len()
    features["word_count"] = df["text"].str.split().str.len()
    features["avg_word_length"] = features["char_count"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["sentence_count"] = df["text"].str.count("[.!?]") + 1
    features["avg_sentence_length"] = features["word_count"] / (
        features["sentence_count"] + 1
    )
    features["exclamation_count"] = df["text"].str.count("!")
    features["question_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\?")
    features["comma_count"] = df["text"].str.count(",")
    features["semicolon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(";")
    features["colon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(":")
    features["dash_count"] = df["text"].str.count("—|-")
    features["quote_count"] = df["text"].str.count('"')
    features["paren_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"[()]")
    features["punctuation_ratio"] = (
        features["exclamation_count"]
        + features["question_count"]
        + features["comma_count"]
        + features["semicolon_count"]
        + features["colon_count"]
        + features["dash_count"]
    ) / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["capital_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z][a-z]*\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1
    )
    features["all_caps_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1
    )
    features["special_char_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"[^a-zA-Z\s]")
    features["numeric_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\d+")
    features["i_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ii]\b")
    features["we_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]e\b")

class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, hidden_size, char_embed_dim=50, kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4, 5], num_filters=32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(256, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(char_embed_dim, num_filters, k, padding=k // 2)
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.proj = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        x = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(x)
            conv_out = F.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        x = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        return self.proj(x)


class StylometricEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=34, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class GatedFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_streams=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * num_streams, num_streams), nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        self.stream_proj = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size) for _ in range(num_streams)]
        )

    def forward(self, *streams):
        concat = torch.cat(streams, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat)
        projected = [self.stream_proj[i](s) for i, s in enumerate(streams)]
        fused = torch.stack(projected, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = gate_weights.unsqueeze(1)
        output = (fused * gate_weights).sum(dim=-1)
        return output


class SpookyAuthorModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large", config=config
        )
        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.char_cnn = CharCNN(hidden_size)
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim, output_dim=hidden_size
        )
        self.fusion = GatedFusion(hidden_size, num_streams=3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.classifier.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.classifier.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, char_ids=None, stylo_features=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-3:]
        weighted_hidden = sum(h * (0.5**i) for i, h in enumerate(hidden_states))
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_embeddings = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)
        debert_rep = sum_embeddings / sum_mask
        debert_rep = self.dropout(debert_rep)
        if char_ids is not None:
            char_rep = self.char_cnn(char_ids)
            char_rep = self.dropout(char_rep)
        else:
            char_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        if stylo_features is not None:
            stylo_rep = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
            stylo_rep = self.dropout(stylo_rep)
        else:
            stylo_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        fused = self.fusion(debert_rep, char_rep, stylo_rep)
        fused = self.dropout(fused)
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, hidden_size, char_embed_dim=50, kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4, 5], num_filters=32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(256, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(char_embed_dim, num_filters, k, padding=k // 2)
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.proj = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        x = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(x)
            conv_out = F.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        x = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        return self.proj(x)


class StylometricEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=34, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class GatedFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_streams=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * num_streams, num_streams), nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        self.stream_proj = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size) for _ in range(num_streams)]
        )

    def forward(self, *streams):
        concat = torch.cat(streams, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat)
        projected = [self.stream_proj[i](s) for i, s in enumerate(streams)]
        fused = torch.stack(projected, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = gate_weights.unsqueeze(1)
        output = (fused * gate_weights).sum(dim=-1)
        return output


class SpookyAuthorModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large", config=config
        )
        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.char_cnn = CharCNN(hidden_size)
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim, output_dim=hidden_size
        )
        self.fusion = GatedFusion(hidden_size, num_streams=3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.classifier.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.classifier.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, char_ids=None, stylo_features=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-3:]
        weighted_hidden = sum(h * (0.5**i) for i, h in enumerate(hidden_states))
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_embeddings = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)
        debert_rep = sum_embeddings / sum_mask
        debert_rep = self.dropout(debert_rep)
        if char_ids is not None:
            char_rep = self.char_cnn(char_ids)
            char_rep = self.dropout(char_rep)
        else:
            char_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        if stylo_features is not None:
            stylo_rep = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
            stylo_rep = self.dropout(stylo_rep)
        else:
            stylo_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        fused = self.fusion(debert_rep, char_rep, stylo_rep)
        fused = self.dropout(fused)
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):

        self.labels = labels

        self.max_length = max_length

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,

            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os

import torch

import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW

from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from transformers import AutoConfig, AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================

test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# ============================================================
# FEATURE ENGINEERING
# ============================================================
def extract_text_features(df, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    features["char_count"] = df["text"].str.len()
    features["word_count"] = df["text"].str.split().str.len()
    features["avg_word_length"] = features["char_count"] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["sentence_count"] = df["text"].str.count("[.!?]") + 1
    features["avg_sentence_length"] = features["word_count"] / (
        features["sentence_count"] + 1
    )
    features["exclamation_count"] = df["text"].str.count("!")
    features["question_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\?")
    features["comma_count"] = df["text"].str.count(",")
    features["semicolon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(";")
    features["colon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(":")
    features["dash_count"] = df["text"].str.count("—|-")
    features["quote_count"] = df["text"].str.count('"')
    features["paren_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"[()]")
    features["punctuation_ratio"] = (
        features["exclamation_count"]
        + features["question_count"]
        + features["comma_count"]
        + features["semicolon_count"]
        + features["colon_count"]
        + features["dash_count"]
    ) / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["capital_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z][a-z]*\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1
    )
    features["all_caps_ratio"] = df["text"].str.findall(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b").str.len() / (
        features["word_count"] + 1
    )
    features["special_char_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"[^a-zA-Z\s]")
    features["numeric_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\d+")
    features["i_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ii]\b")
    features["we_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]e\b")
    features["you_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Yy]ou\b")
    features["he_she_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Hh]e\b|\b[Ss]he\b")
    features["it_pronoun_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ii]t\b")
    features["the_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Tt]he\b")
    features["and_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Aa]nd\b")
    features["but_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Bb]ut\b")
    features["for_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ff]or\b")
    features["with_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]ith\b")
    features["upon_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Uu]pon\b")
    features["which_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]hich\b")
    features["that_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Tt]hat\b")
    features["not_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Nn]ot\b")
    features["was_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]as\b")
    features["had_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Hh]ad\b")
    features["were_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\b[Ww]ere\b")
    for col in [
        "the_count",
        "and_count",
        "but_count",
        "for_count",
        "with_count",
        "upon_count",
        "which_count",
        "that_count",
        "not_count",
        "was_count",
        "had_count",
        "were_count",
    ]:
        features[f"{col}_density"] = features[col] / (features["word_count"] + 1)
    features["ellipsis_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"\.\.\.|…")
    features["em_dash_count"] = df["text"].str.count(r"—|--")
    features["unique_word_ratio"] = df["text"].apply(
        lambda x: len(set(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x).lower())))
        / max(len(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x))), 1)
    )
    stop_words = [
        "the",

        "but",

        "at",

        "this",

        "i",

        "me",

        "my",

        "his",
        "her",
        "its",
        "our",
        "their",
        "mine",
        "yours",
        "his",
        "hers",
        "its",
        "ours",
        "theirs",
    ]
    features["stop_word_ratio"] = df["text"].apply(
        lambda x: sum(
            1 for w in re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x).lower()) if w in stop_words
        )
        / max(len(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x))), 1)
    )
    all_words = df["text"].apply(lambda x: re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", str(x)))
    features["short_word_ratio"] = all_words.apply(
        lambda words: sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 3) / max(len(words), 1)
    )
    features["medium_word_ratio"] = all_words.apply(
        lambda words: sum(1 for w in words if 4 <= len(w) <= 7) / max(len(words), 1)
    )
    features["long_word_ratio"] = all_words.apply(
        lambda words: sum(1 for w in words if len(w) >= 8) / max(len(words), 1)

le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_full = le.fit_transform(train_df["author"])

# ============================================================
# TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT (FIRST - to avoid data leakage)

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))

print("Extracting text features on train split only...")
train_features = extract_text_features(train_df_split, is_train=True)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 5),
    max_features=5000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.8,
)
char_tfidf_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df_split["text"])
char_tfidf_val = char_vectorizer.transform(val_df_split["text"])
char_tfidf_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])

word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=3000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.8,
    stop_words="english",
)
word_tfidf_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df_split["text"])
word_tfidf_val = word_vectorizer.transform(val_df_split["text"])
word_tfidf_test = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])

feature_cols = train_features.columns
scaler = StandardScaler()
train_features_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(train_features)
val_features_scaled = scaler.transform(val_features)
test_features_scaled = scaler.transform(test_features)
train_features_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    train_features_scaled, columns=feature_cols, index=train_features.index
)
val_features_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    val_features_scaled, columns=feature_cols, index=val_features.index
)
test_features_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    test_features_scaled, columns=feature_cols, index=test_features.index
)

train_dense_sparse = csr_matrix(train_features_scaled.values)
val_dense_sparse = csr_matrix(val_features_scaled.values)
test_dense_sparse = csr_matrix(test_features_scaled.values)
X_train = hstack([train_dense_sparse, char_tfidf_train, word_tfidf_train])
X_val = hstack([val_dense_sparse, char_tfidf_val, word_tfidf_val])
X_test = hstack([test_dense_sparse, char_tfidf_test, word_tfidf_test])
print(f"Combined train shape: {X_train.shape}")

# ============================================================
# MODEL DESIGN - DeBERTa-v3-large with gated fusion, char-cnn, stylo
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")


class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, hidden_size, char_embed_dim=50, kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4, 5], num_filters=32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(256, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(char_embed_dim, num_filters, k, padding=k // 2)
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.proj = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        x = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(x)
            conv_out = F.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        x = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        return self.proj(x)


class StylometricEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=34, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class GatedFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_streams=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * num_streams, num_streams), nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        self.stream_proj = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size) for _ in range(num_streams)]
        )

    def forward(self, *streams):
        concat = torch.cat(streams, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat)
        projected = [self.stream_proj[i](s) for i, s in enumerate(streams)]
        fused = torch.stack(projected, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = gate_weights.unsqueeze(1)
        output = (fused * gate_weights).sum(dim=-1)
        return output


class SpookyAuthorModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large", config=config
        )
        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.char_cnn = CharCNN(hidden_size)
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim, output_dim=hidden_size
        )
        self.fusion = GatedFusion(hidden_size, num_streams=3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.classifier.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.classifier.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, char_ids=None, stylo_features=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-3:]
        weighted_hidden = sum(h * (0.5**i) for i, h in enumerate(hidden_states))
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_embeddings = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)
        debert_rep = sum_embeddings / sum_mask
        debert_rep = self.dropout(debert_rep)
        if char_ids is not None:
            char_rep = self.char_cnn(char_ids)
            char_rep = self.dropout(char_rep)
        else:
            char_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        if stylo_features is not None:
            stylo_rep = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
            stylo_rep = self.dropout(stylo_rep)
        else:
            stylo_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        fused = self.fusion(debert_rep, char_rep, stylo_rep)
        fused = self.dropout(fused)
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorModel(
    num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
).to(device)
print(f"Total parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")
print(

)

for layer in model.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:

for module in [model.char_cnn, model.stylo_encoder, model.fusion, model.classifier]:

        {"params": backbone_no_wd, "lr": 2e-5, "weight_decay": 0.0},
        {"params": head_wd, "lr": 5e-5, "weight_decay": 0.01},

    ],
    betas=(0.9, 0.98),

# ============================================================
# DATASET AND DATALOADER

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


train_texts = train_df["text"].values
train_labels = np.array(
    [{"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}[a] for a in train_df["author"].values]
)
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

train_texts_final = train_texts[train_idx]
train_labels_final = train_labels[train_idx]
val_texts_final = train_texts[val_idx]
val_labels_final = train_labels[val_idx]

batch_size = 16
max_length = 512

train_dataset = SpookyDataset(
    train_texts_final, train_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length
)
val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts_final, val_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length)
test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 30
patience = 5
best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)

total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=total_steps // 2, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)
initial_lrs = [group["lr"] for group in optimizer.param_groups]
stylometric_dim = 34

# Prepare stylometric features for training/val (use X_train which has all features)
# We need to extract the first 34 columns from X_train for stylo features
# X_train is hstack of [train_dense_sparse (34 cols), char_tfidf, word_tfidf]
stylo_train_full = (
    X_train[:, :34].toarray()
    if X_train.shape[1] >= 34
    else np.zeros((len(train_texts_final), stylometric_dim))
)
stylo_val_full = (
    X_val[:, :34].toarray()
    if X_val.shape[1] >= 34
    else np.zeros((len(val_texts_final), stylometric_dim))
)
stylo_test_full = (
    X_test[:, :34].toarray()
    if X_test.shape[1] >= 34
    else np.zeros((len(test_texts), stylometric_dim))
)

# Build dicts mapping original indices to stylo features for proper alignment with shuffled DataLoader
train_stylo_dict = {i: stylo_train_full[i] for i in range(len(stylo_train_full))}
val_stylo_dict = {i: stylo_val_full[i] for i in range(len(stylo_val_full))}

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            # Use stylometric features for this batch - aligned via index in dataset
            batch_indices = batch.get("index", None)
            if batch_indices is not None:
                stylo_batch = torch.tensor(
                    np.array([train_stylo_dict[i.item()] for i in batch_indices]),
                    dtype=torch.float
                ).to(device)
            else:
                stylo_batch = torch.zeros(input_ids.shape[0], stylometric_dim).to(device)
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, stylo_features=stylo_batch)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()
        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx
        if current_step < warmup_steps:

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, hidden_size, char_embed_dim=50, kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4, 5], num_filters=32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embed = nn.Embedding(256, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(char_embed_dim, num_filters, k, padding=k // 2)
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.proj = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        x = self.char_embed(char_ids)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(x)
            conv_out = F.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        x = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        return self.proj(x)


class StylometricEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=34, hidden_dim=64, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class GatedFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_streams=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * num_streams, num_streams), nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        self.stream_proj = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size) for _ in range(num_streams)]
        )

    def forward(self, *streams):
        concat = torch.cat(streams, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat)
        projected = [self.stream_proj[i](s) for i, s in enumerate(streams)]
        fused = torch.stack(projected, dim=-1)
        gate_weights = gate_weights.unsqueeze(1)
        output = (fused * gate_weights).sum(dim=-1)
        return output


class SpookyAuthorModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=34, char_vocab_size=256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large", config=config
        )
        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.char_cnn = CharCNN(hidden_size)
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim, output_dim=hidden_size
        )
        self.fusion = GatedFusion(hidden_size, num_streams=3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.classifier.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.classifier.bias)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, char_ids=None, stylo_features=None):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-3:]
        weighted_hidden = sum(h * (0.5**i) for i, h in enumerate(hidden_states))
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_embeddings = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        sum_mask = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)
        debert_rep = sum_embeddings / sum_mask
        debert_rep = self.dropout(debert_rep)
        if char_ids is not None:
            char_rep = self.char_cnn(char_ids)
            char_rep = self.dropout(char_rep)
        else:
            char_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        if stylo_features is not None:
            stylo_rep = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
            stylo_rep = self.dropout(stylo_rep)
        else:
            stylo_rep = torch.zeros_like(debert_rep)
        fused = self.fusion(debert_rep, char_rep, stylo_rep)
        fused = self.dropout(fused)
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits

class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state
        cls_pool = hidden_states[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.head(cls_pool)
        return logits

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

# Linear warmup, then cosine annealing
total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs

# Initialize scheduler
scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=total_steps // 2, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)

# Save initial LR for warmup scaling

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
