import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Train/Validation split (StratifiedKFold)
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))

train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

le = LabelEncoder()
train_set["author"] = le.fit_transform(train_set["author"])
val_set["author"] = le.transform(val_set["author"])

os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# MODEL DESIGN - DeBERTa-v3-large
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        # Attention pooling head
        self.attention_pool = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)
        # Compute attention weights over sequence tokens
        attn_logits = self.attention_pool(hidden_states)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
        # Expand attention_mask for broadcasting: (batch, seq_len) -> (batch, seq_len, 1)
        mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e9)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_logits, dim=1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
        # Weighted sum pooling
        pooled = (hidden_states * attn_weights).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
        pooled = self.dropout(pooled)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorClassifier(num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3)
model.to(device)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

# Collect backbone unfrozen params (last 8 layers)
backbone_unfrozen_params = []
for layer in model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
    for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
        if "bias" not in name and "LayerNorm" not in name:
            backbone_unfrozen_params.append(param)

# Collect head params (only the new single linear layer)
head_params = list(model.classifier.parameters())

optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {
            "params": backbone_unfrozen_params,
            "lr": 2e-5,
            "weight_decay": 0.01,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        },
        {"params": head_params, "lr": 5e-5, "weight_decay": 0.01, "betas": (0.9, 0.98)},
    ],
    weight_decay=0.01,
    betas=(0.9, 0.999),
)

print(f"Backbone unfrozen params: {sum(p.numel() for p in backbone_unfrozen_params):,}")
print(f"Head params: {sum(p.numel() for p in head_params):,}")
print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")


# ============================================================
# DATASET AND DATALOADER
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# Get original texts for training
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_texts_orig = train_df["text"].values
train_labels_orig = np.array([author_map[a] for a in train_df["author"].values])
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Use previously computed indices for train/validation split
train_indices = train_set.index.tolist()
val_indices = val_set.index.tolist()

train_texts_final = train_texts_orig[train_indices]
train_labels_final = train_labels_orig[train_indices]
val_texts_final = train_texts_orig[val_indices]
val_labels_final = train_labels_orig[val_indices]

batch_size = 16
max_length = 512

train_dataset = SpookyDataset(
    train_texts_final, train_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length
)
val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts_final, val_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length)
test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 30
patience = 5
best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()

# Linear warmup, then cosine decay to 0
num_epochs = 40
total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)

# Store initial LRs for warmup scaling
initial_lrs = [param_group["lr"] for param_group in optimizer.param_groups]

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        # Compute the current global step
        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx

        # Linear warmup
        if current_step < warmup_steps:
            warmup_factor = current_step / max(1, warmup_steps)
            for i, param_group in enumerate(optimizer.param_groups):
                param_group["lr"] = initial_lrs[i] * warmup_factor
        else:
            # Cosine decay from initial_lr to 0 after warmup
            progress = (current_step - warmup_steps) / max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps)
            cosine_decay = 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * progress))
            for i, param_group in enumerate(optimizer.param_groups):
                param_group["lr"] = initial_lrs[i] * cosine_decay

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches

    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
    )

    if val_score < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_score
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND EVALUATE
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()

all_val_probs = []
all_val_labels = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
        all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
final_val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

# ============================================================
# TEST INFERENCE
# ============================================================
all_test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

test_probs = np.concatenate(all_test_probs, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

epsilon = 1e-15
for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    submission[col] = np.clip(submission[col], epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

row_sums = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)
submission["EAP"] = submission["EAP"] / row_sums
submission["HPL"] = submission["HPL"] / row_sums
submission["MWS"] = submission["MWS"] / row_sums

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")

## Description

How will I ever figure out how to put them back together according to the authors who wrote them? Or are they lost, forevermore? Wait, I thought... I know, machine learning!

In this year's Halloween playground competition, you're challenged to predict the author of excerpts from horror stories by Edgar Allan Poe, Mary Shelley, and HP Lovecraft.

### Getting Started

New to Kernels or working with natural language data? We've put together some starter kernels in Python and R to help you hit the ground running.

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

where N is the number of observations in the test set, M is the number of class labels (3 classes), \\(log\\) is the natural logarithm, \\(y_{ij}\\) is 1 if observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\) and 0 otherwise, and \\(p_{ij}\\) is the predicted probability that observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\).

The submitted probabilities for a given sentences are not required to sum to one because they are rescaled prior to being scored (each row is divided by the row sum). In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

### Submission File

You must submit a csv file with the id, and a probability for each of the three classes. The order of the rows does not matter. The file must have a header and should look like the following:

```
id,EAP,HPL,MWS
id07943,0.33,0.33,0.33
...
```

# Dataset Description

The competition dataset contains text from works of fiction written by spooky authors of the public domain: Edgar Allan Poe, HP Lovecraft and Mary Shelley. The data was prepared by chunking larger texts into sentences using CoreNLP's MaxEnt sentence tokenizer, so you may notice the odd non-sentence here and there. Your objective is to accurately identify the author of the sentences in the test set.

## File descriptions

- **train.csv** - the training set
- **test.csv** - the test set
- **sample_submission.csv** - a sample submission file in the correct format

## Data fields

- **id** - a unique identifier for each sentence
- **text** - some text written by one of the authors
- **author** - the author of the sentence (EAP: Edgar Allan Poe, HPL: HP Lovecraft; MWS: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Train/Validation split (StratifiedKFold, same split as original)
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))

train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

le = LabelEncoder()
train_set["author"] = le.fit_transform(train_set["author"])
val_set["author"] = le.transform(val_set["author"])

os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# MODEL DESIGN - DeBERTa-v3-large
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.attention_pool = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        self.num_authors = num_authors
        self.dropout_rate = dropout_rate

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, use_multi_sample=False):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state
        # Compute attention weights for all tokens (excluding padding)
        attn_weights = self.attention_pool(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        # Set attention weights of padding tokens to -inf
        attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, float('-inf'))
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        # Weighted sum over sequence dimension
        pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), hidden_states).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, hidden_size)
        pooled = self.dropout(pooled)
        logits = self.head(pooled)
        if use_multi_sample:
            # Multi-sample dropout: K=3 passes with dropout enabled, average softmax
            with torch.no_grad():
                self.train()  # Enable dropout for multi-sample
                probs_list = []
                for _ in range(3):
                    pooled_ms = self.dropout(pooled)
                    logits_ms = self.head(pooled_ms)
                    probs_ms = torch.softmax(logits_ms, dim=1)
                    probs_list.append(probs_ms)
                self.eval()  # Revert to eval mode
                avg_probs = torch.stack(probs_list).mean(dim=0)
                logits = torch.log(avg_probs + 1e-10)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorClassifier(num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3)
model.to(device)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
# LLRD: layer-wise learning rate decay for last 8 backbone layers
# Each layer lr = base_lr * 0.95^(i), i=0 for layer 24, i=1 for layer 23, etc.
# Separate attention params (lr=2e-5, wd=0.01) from feed-forward params (lr=2e-5, wd=0.1)
# Remove weight decay from bias and LayerNorm params
base_lr = 2e-5
param_groups = []

# Head params (linear)
head_params = list(model.head.parameters())
param_groups.append({
    "params": head_params,
    "lr": 5e-5,
    "weight_decay": 0.01,
    "betas": (0.9, 0.98),
})

# Backbone last 8 layers with LLRD
num_layers = len(model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer)
for idx, layer in enumerate(model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]):
    layer_idx = num_layers - 8 + idx
    i = (num_layers - 1) - layer_idx  # i=0 for layer 24, i=1 for layer 23, etc.
    layer_lr = base_lr * (0.95 ** i)

    # Separate attention vs feed-forward params
    attention_params = []
    ffn_params = []
    no_wd_params = []

    for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
        if "bias" in name or "LayerNorm" in name or "layernorm" in name:
            no_wd_params.append(param)
        elif "attention" in name.lower():
            attention_params.append(param)
        else:
            ffn_params.append(param)

    if attention_params:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": attention_params,
            "lr": layer_lr,
            "weight_decay": 0.01,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        })
    if ffn_params:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": ffn_params,
            "lr": layer_lr,
            "weight_decay": 0.1,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        })
    if no_wd_params:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": no_wd_params,
            "lr": layer_lr,
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        })

optimizer = AdamW(param_groups, weight_decay=0.01, betas=(0.9, 0.999))

backbone_unfrozen_params = list(model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:].parameters())
print(f"Backbone unfrozen params: {sum(p.numel() for p in backbone_unfrozen_params):,}")
print(f"Head params: {sum(p.numel() for p in head_params):,}")
print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")


# ============================================================
# DATASET AND DATALOADER
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# Get original texts for training
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_texts_orig = train_df["text"].values
train_labels_orig = np.array([author_map[a] for a in train_df["author"].values])
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Use previously computed indices for train/validation split
train_indices = train_set.index.tolist()
val_indices = val_set.index.tolist()

train_texts_final = train_texts_orig[train_indices]
train_labels_final = train_labels_orig[train_indices]
val_texts_final = train_texts_orig[val_indices]
val_labels_final = train_labels_orig[val_indices]

batch_size = 16
max_length = 512

train_dataset = SpookyDataset(
    train_texts_final, train_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length
)
val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts_final, val_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length)
test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 30
patience = 3
best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Linear warmup + cosine decay scheduler
total_steps = num_epochs * len(train_loader)
warmup_steps = int(total_steps * 0.1)  # 10% warmup

def lr_lambda(current_step):
    if current_step < warmup_steps:
        return float(current_step) / float(max(1, warmup_steps))
    # Cosine decay to 1e-7
    progress = float(current_step - warmup_steps) / float(max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps))
    return max(1e-7 / base_lr, 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * progress)))

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(optimizer, lr_lambda)

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    # Step scheduler per epoch
    scheduler.step()

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches

    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
    )

    if val_score < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_score
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND EVALUATE
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()

all_val_probs = []
all_val_labels = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
        all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
final_val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

# ============================================================
# TEST INFERENCE (with multi-sample dropout K=3)
# ============================================================
all_test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, use_multi_sample=True)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

test_probs = np.concatenate(all_test_probs, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

epsilon = 1e-15
for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    submission[col] = np.clip(submission[col], epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

row_sums = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)
submission["EAP"] = submission["EAP"] / row_sums
submission["HPL"] = submission["HPL"] / row_sums
submission["MWS"] = submission["MWS"] / row_sums

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")

## Description

As I scurried across the candlelit chamber, manuscripts in hand, I thought I'd made it. Nothing would be able to hurt me anymore. Little did I know there was one last fright lurking around the corner.

In this year's Halloween playground competition, you're challenged to predict the author of excerpts from horror stories by Edgar Allan Poe, Mary Shelley, and HP Lovecraft.

### Getting Started

New to Kernels or working with natural language data? We've put together some starter kernels in Python and R to help you hit the ground running.

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

where N is the number of observations in the test set, M is the number of class labels (3 classes), \\(log\\) is the natural logarithm, \\(y_{ij}\\) is 1 if observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\) and 0 otherwise, and \\(p_{ij}\\) is the predicted probability that observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\).

The submitted probabilities for a given sentences are not required to sum to one because they are rescaled prior to being scored (each row is divided by the row sum). In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts, LinearLR, SequentialLR
import copy
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Train/Validation split (StratifiedKFold, same split as original)
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))

train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

le = LabelEncoder()
train_set["author"] = le.fit_transform(train_set["author"])
val_set["author"] = le.transform(val_set["author"])

os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# MODEL DESIGN - DeBERTa-v3-large
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        # Multi-head self-attention pooling (4 heads) with learnable query token
        self.num_heads = 4
        self.attn_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=self.num_heads,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Learnable query token for attention pooling
        self.query_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_size))
        # Two-layer feed-forward network
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(768, hidden_size),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.final_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)
        batch_size = hidden_states.size(0)
        # Expand query token for batch
        query = self.query_token.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Create key_padding_mask from attention_mask (True for padding tokens)
        key_padding_mask = ~attention_mask.bool()
        # Multi-head attention pooling
        attn_output, _ = self.attn_pool(
            query=query,
            key=hidden_states,
            value=hidden_states,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )  # attn_output: (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        pooled_attn = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
        # Mean pooling as residual connection
        mean_pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()).sum(dim=1) / \
                      attention_mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).float().clamp(min=1e-9)
        pooled = pooled_attn + mean_pooled  # Residual connection from mean pooling
        # Apply feed-forward network with residual connection
        ffn_out = self.ffn(pooled)
        combined = pooled + ffn_out
        logits = self.final_head(combined)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorClassifier(num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3)
model.to(device)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
# Collect backbone unfrozen params (last 8 layers)
backbone_unfrozen_params = []
for layer in model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
    for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
        if "bias" not in name and "LayerNorm" not in name:
            backbone_unfrozen_params.append(param)

# Collect head params (attention pooling + FFN + final linear layer + query_token)
head_params = (
    list(model.attn_pool.parameters())
    + [model.query_token]
    + list(model.ffn.parameters())
    + list(model.final_head.parameters())
)

optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {
            "params": backbone_unfrozen_params,
            "lr": 2e-5,
            "weight_decay": 0.01,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        },
        {"params": head_params, "lr": 5e-5, "weight_decay": 0.01, "betas": (0.9, 0.98)},
    ],
    weight_decay=0.01,
    betas=(0.9, 0.999),
)

print(f"Backbone unfrozen params: {sum(p.numel() for p in backbone_unfrozen_params):,}")
print(f"Head params: {sum(p.numel() for p in head_params):,}")
print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")


# ============================================================
# DATASET AND DATALOADER
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# Get original texts for training
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_texts_orig = train_df["text"].values
train_labels_orig = np.array([author_map[a] for a in train_df["author"].values])
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Use previously computed indices for train/validation split
train_indices = train_set.index.tolist()
val_indices = val_set.index.tolist()

train_texts_final = train_texts_orig[train_indices]
train_labels_final = train_labels_orig[train_indices]
val_texts_final = train_texts_orig[val_indices]
val_labels_final = train_labels_orig[val_indices]

batch_size = 16
max_length = 512

train_dataset = SpookyDataset(
    train_texts_final, train_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length
)
val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts_final, val_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length)
test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 40
patience = 4
best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Create EMA teacher model
ema_model = copy.deepcopy(model)
for param in ema_model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
ema_model.eval()

# Per-epoch CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts with linear warmup
total_epochs = num_epochs
warmup_epochs = max(1, int(0.1 * total_epochs))
cosine_scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=5, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)
warmup_scheduler = LinearLR(optimizer, start_factor=0.1, total_iters=warmup_epochs)
scheduler = SequentialLR(
    optimizer,
    schedulers=[warmup_scheduler, cosine_scheduler],
    milestones=[warmup_epochs],
)

# EMA update function
def update_ema(ema_model, model, decay=0.999):
    with torch.no_grad():
        for ema_param, param in zip(ema_model.parameters(), model.parameters()):
            ema_param.data.mul_(decay).add_(param.data, alpha=1 - decay)

# Self-distillation KL loss function
def kl_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, temperature=3.0):
    student_soft = F.log_softmax(student_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    teacher_soft = F.softmax(teacher_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    return F.kl_div(student_soft, teacher_soft, reduction='batchmean') * (temperature ** 2)

# Weight for distillation loss
distill_weight = 0.3

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    total_ce_loss = 0
    total_distill_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            loss_ce = criterion(logits, labels)
            with torch.no_grad():
                teacher_logits = ema_model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            loss_distill = kl_loss(logits, teacher_logits, temperature=3.0)
            loss = (1 - distill_weight) * loss_ce + distill_weight * loss_distill

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        # Update EMA teacher after each step
        update_ema(ema_model, model, decay=0.999)

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        total_ce_loss += loss_ce.item()
        total_distill_loss += loss_distill.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    # Step scheduler per epoch
    scheduler.step()

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches
    avg_ce_loss = total_ce_loss / num_train_batches
    avg_distill_loss = total_distill_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches

    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | CE: {avg_ce_loss:.4f} | Distill: {avg_distill_loss:.4f} | Total: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
    )

    if val_score < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_score
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
        # Also save EMA model state
        torch.save(ema_model.state_dict(), "./working/best_ema_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND EVALUATE (use EMA for inference)
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_ema_model.pt"))
model.eval()

all_val_probs = []
all_val_labels = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
        all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
final_val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

# ============================================================
# TEST INFERENCE (use EMA teacher for better generalization)
# ============================================================
all_test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

test_probs = np.concatenate(all_test_probs, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

epsilon = 1e-15
for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    submission[col] = np.clip(submission[col], epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

row_sums = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)
submission["EAP"] = submission["EAP"] / row_sums
submission["HPL"] = submission["HPL"] / row_sums
submission["MWS"] = submission["MWS"] / row_sums

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")

    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )

            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        # Multi-head self-attention pooling (4 heads) with learnable query token
        self.num_heads = 4
        self.attn_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=self.num_heads,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Learnable query token for attention pooling
        self.query_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_size))
        # Two-layer feed-forward network
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(768, hidden_size),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.final_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)
        batch_size = hidden_states.size(0)
        # Expand query token for batch
        query = self.query_token.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Create key_padding_mask from attention_mask (True for padding tokens)
        key_padding_mask = ~attention_mask.bool()
        # Multi-head attention pooling
        attn_output, _ = self.attn_pool(
            query=query,
            key=hidden_states,
            value=hidden_states,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )  # attn_output: (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        pooled_attn = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
        # Mean pooling as residual connection
        mean_pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()).sum(dim=1) / \
                      attention_mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).float().clamp(min=1e-9)
        pooled = pooled_attn + mean_pooled  # Residual connection from mean pooling
        # Apply feed-forward network with residual connection
        ffn_out = self.ffn(pooled)
        combined = pooled + ffn_out
        logits = self.final_head(combined)
        return logits

def kl_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, temperature=3.0):
    student_soft = F.log_softmax(student_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    teacher_soft = F.softmax(teacher_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    return F.kl_div(student_soft, teacher_soft, reduction='batchmean') * (temperature ** 2)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Train/Validation split (StratifiedKFold, same split as original)
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))

train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

val_set["author"] = le.transform(val_set["author"])

# ============================================================
# MODEL DESIGN - DeBERTa-v3-large
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Initially freeze all backbone layers - progressive unfreezing will be done externally
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False

        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        # Improved pooling: mean pooling + attention pooling with learnable gate
        self.attention_pool = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
        )
        # Learnable gate to combine mean pool and attention pool
        self.gate = nn.Linear(hidden_size * 2, 1)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)
        self.num_authors = num_authors
        self.dropout_rate = dropout_rate
        # Track unfreeze stage for progressive unfreezing
        self.unfreeze_stage = 0  # 0: head only, 1: last 8 layers, 2: last 16 layers, 3: all
        self._set_unfreeze_stage(0)

    def _set_unfreeze_stage(self, stage):
        """Set which layers are trainable based on stage."""
        self.unfreeze_stage = stage
        # First freeze all backbone
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False

        if stage >= 1:
            # Unfreeze last 8 layers
            for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True
        if stage >= 2:
            # Unfreeze last 16 layers
            for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-16:]:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True
        if stage >= 3:
            # Unfreeze all
            for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, use_multi_sample=False):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Mean pooling over non-padding tokens
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch_size, seq_len, 1)
        mean_pooled = (hidden_states * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1) / mask_expanded.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-9)

        # Attention pooling
        attn_weights = self.attention_pool(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, float('-inf'))
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1)
        attn_pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), hidden_states).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, hidden_size)

        # Combine via learnable gate
        combined = torch.cat([mean_pooled, attn_pooled], dim=-1)  # (batch_size, hidden_size*2)
        gate_weight = torch.sigmoid(self.gate(combined))  # (batch_size, 1)
        pooled = gate_weight * attn_pooled + (1 - gate_weight) * mean_pooled

        pooled = self.dropout(pooled)
        logits = self.head(pooled)

        if use_multi_sample:
            # Multi-sample dropout: K=3 passes with dropout enabled, average softmax
            with torch.no_grad():
                self.train()  # Enable dropout for multi-sample
                probs_list = []
                for _ in range(3):
                    pooled_ms = self.dropout(pooled)
                    logits_ms = self.head(pooled_ms)
                    probs_ms = torch.softmax(logits_ms, dim=1)
                    probs_list.append(probs_ms)
                self.eval()  # Revert to eval mode
                avg_probs = torch.stack(probs_list).mean(dim=0)
                logits = torch.log(avg_probs + 1e-10)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorClassifier(num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3)

def build_optimizer(model, head_lr=5e-5, backbone_lr=2e-5, layer_decay=0.95, weight_decay=0.01):
    """Build optimizer with LLRD and proper param groups."""
    param_groups = []

    # Head params - no weight decay for bias/LayerNorm
    head_params_no_wd = []
    head_params_wd = []
    for name, param in model.head.named_parameters():
        if "bias" in name or "LayerNorm" in name or "layernorm" in name:
            head_params_no_wd.append(param)
        else:
            head_params_wd.append(param)

    if head_params_wd:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": head_params_wd,
            "lr": head_lr,
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        })
    if head_params_no_wd:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": head_params_no_wd,
            "lr": head_lr,
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        })

    # Gate and attention pool params (also head-level LR)
    extra_params_no_wd = []
    extra_params_wd = []
    for name, param in model.gate.named_parameters():
        if "bias" in name:
            extra_params_no_wd.append(param)
        else:
            extra_params_wd.append(param)
    for name, param in model.attention_pool.named_parameters():
        if "bias" in name or "LayerNorm" in name or "layernorm" in name:
            extra_params_no_wd.append(param)
        else:
            extra_params_wd.append(param)

    if extra_params_wd:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": extra_params_wd,
            "lr": head_lr,
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        })
    if extra_params_no_wd:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": extra_params_no_wd,
            "lr": head_lr,
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        })

    # Backbone layers with LLRD - iterate through all layers in reverse order
    num_layers = len(model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer)
    for layer_idx in range(num_layers - 1, -1, -1):
        layer = model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[layer_idx]
        # Only add params if this layer is trainable
        if not any(p.requires_grad for p in layer.parameters()):
            continue

        i = (num_layers - 1) - layer_idx  # i=0 for last layer, increasing for earlier layers
        layer_lr = backbone_lr * (layer_decay ** i)

        # Separate attention vs feed-forward params, remove WD from bias/LayerNorm
        attention_params = []
        ffn_params = []
        no_wd_params = []

        for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
            if "bias" in name or "LayerNorm" in name or "layernorm" in name:
                no_wd_params.append(param)
            elif "attention" in name.lower():
                attention_params.append(param)
            else:
                ffn_params.append(param)

        if attention_params:
            param_groups.append({
                "params": attention_params,
                "lr": layer_lr,
                "weight_decay": weight_decay,
            })
        if ffn_params:
            param_groups.append({
                "params": ffn_params,
                "lr": layer_lr,
                "weight_decay": weight_decay * 10,  # Higher WD for FFN
            })
        if no_wd_params:
            param_groups.append({
                "params": no_wd_params,
                "lr": layer_lr,
                "weight_decay": 0.0,
            })

    return AdamW(param_groups, weight_decay=weight_decay)

optimizer = build_optimizer(model)

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):

class WarmupCosineScheduler:
    """Per-batch linear warmup + cosine decay scheduler."""
    def __init__(self, optimizer, warmup_steps, total_steps, min_lr_ratio=0.02):
        self.optimizer = optimizer
        self.warmup_steps = warmup_steps
        self.total_steps = total_steps
        self.min_lr_ratio = min_lr_ratio
        self.current_step = 0
        self.base_lrs = [group["lr"] for group in optimizer.param_groups]

    def step(self):
        self.current_step += 1
        step = self.current_step
        for i, group in enumerate(self.optimizer.param_groups):
            base_lr = self.base_lrs[i]
            if step < self.warmup_steps:
                # Linear warmup
                lr = base_lr * (step / max(1, self.warmup_steps))
            else:
                # Cosine decay
                progress = (step - self.warmup_steps) / max(1, self.total_steps - self.warmup_steps)
                lr = base_lr * (self.min_lr_ratio + 0.5 * (1 - self.min_lr_ratio) * (1 + np.cos(np.pi * progress)))
            group["lr"] = lr

    elif epoch == 8:

        optimizer = build_optimizer(model)

            swa_scheduler.step()
        else:

        num_train_batches += 1

    if swa_model is not None and epoch >= swa_start_epoch:

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches

    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
    )

    if val_score < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_score
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts, LinearLR, SequentialLR
import copy
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Train/Validation split (StratifiedKFold, same split as original)
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))

train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

le = LabelEncoder()
train_set["author"] = le.fit_transform(train_set["author"])
val_set["author"] = le.transform(val_set["author"])

os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# MODEL DESIGN - DeBERTa-v3-large
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        # Multi-head self-attention pooling (4 heads) with learnable query token
        self.num_heads = 4
        self.attn_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=self.num_heads,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Learnable query token for attention pooling
        self.query_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_size))
        # Two-layer feed-forward network
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(768, hidden_size),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.final_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)
        batch_size = hidden_states.size(0)
        # Expand query token for batch
        query = self.query_token.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Create key_padding_mask from attention_mask (True for padding tokens)
        key_padding_mask = ~attention_mask.bool()
        # Multi-head attention pooling
        attn_output, _ = self.attn_pool(
            query=query,
            key=hidden_states,
            value=hidden_states,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )  # attn_output: (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        pooled_attn = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
        # Mean pooling as residual connection
        mean_pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()).sum(dim=1) / \
                      attention_mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).float().clamp(min=1e-9)
        pooled = pooled_attn + mean_pooled  # Residual connection from mean pooling
        # Apply feed-forward network with residual connection
        ffn_out = self.ffn(pooled)
        combined = pooled + ffn_out
        logits = self.final_head(combined)
        return logits


model = SpookyAuthorClassifier(num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3)
model.to(device)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
# Collect backbone unfrozen params (last 8 layers)
backbone_unfrozen_params = []
for layer in model.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
    for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
        if "bias" not in name and "LayerNorm" not in name:
            backbone_unfrozen_params.append(param)

# Collect head params (attention pooling + FFN + final linear layer + query_token)
head_params = (
    list(model.attn_pool.parameters())
    + [model.query_token]
    + list(model.ffn.parameters())
    + list(model.final_head.parameters())
)

optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {
            "params": backbone_unfrozen_params,
            "lr": 2e-5,
            "weight_decay": 0.01,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        },
        {"params": head_params, "lr": 5e-5, "weight_decay": 0.01, "betas": (0.9, 0.98)},
    ],
    weight_decay=0.01,
    betas=(0.9, 0.999),
)

print(f"Backbone unfrozen params: {sum(p.numel() for p in backbone_unfrozen_params):,}")
print(f"Head params: {sum(p.numel() for p in head_params):,}")
print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")


# ============================================================
# DATASET AND DATALOADER
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# Get original texts for training
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_texts_orig = train_df["text"].values
train_labels_orig = np.array([author_map[a] for a in train_df["author"].values])
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Use previously computed indices for train/validation split
train_indices = train_set.index.tolist()
val_indices = val_set.index.tolist()

train_texts_final = train_texts_orig[train_indices]
train_labels_final = train_labels_orig[train_indices]
val_texts_final = train_texts_orig[val_indices]
val_labels_final = train_labels_orig[val_indices]

batch_size = 16
max_length = 512

train_dataset = SpookyDataset(
    train_texts_final, train_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length
)
val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts_final, val_labels_final, tokenizer, max_length)
test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 60
patience = 8
best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Mixout implementation: parameter-level dropout that reverts to pretrained weights
class MixoutLinear(nn.Module):
    """Helper wrapper to apply Mixout to a single linear layer."""
    def __init__(self, original_layer, original_weight, p_replace=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.original_layer = original_layer
        self.original_weight = original_weight  # pretrained weight tensor
        self.p_replace = p_replace

    def forward(self, x):
        if not self.training or self.p_replace == 0:
            return self.original_layer(x)
        # Apply Mixout: randomly replace weights with original pretrained values
        weight = self.original_layer.weight
        mask = torch.bernoulli(torch.full_like(weight, self.p_replace)).bool()
        mixed_weight = torch.where(mask, self.original_weight, weight)
        # Handle bias if present
        if self.original_layer.bias is not None:
            # For bias, we keep learned bias (Mixout paper typically only masks weights)
            return F.linear(x, mixed_weight, self.original_layer.bias)
        return F.linear(x, mixed_weight, None)

def apply_mixout_to_model(model, p_replace=0.1):
    """Replace Linear layers in backbone with Mixout versions, saving original pretrained weights."""
    # Store original pretrained weights from backbone
    original_weights = {}
    for name, param in model.backbone.named_parameters():
        if 'weight' in name and 'bias' not in name and 'LayerNorm' not in name:
            original_weights[name] = param.data.clone().detach()

    # Replace Linear layers in backbone with Mixout wrappers
    for name, module in model.backbone.named_modules():
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear) and 'LayerNorm' not in name and 'bias' not in name:
            # Find the weight name for this module
            weight_name = name + '.weight'
            if weight_name in original_weights:
                mixout_layer = MixoutLinear(module, original_weights[weight_name], p_replace)
                # Need to update the parent module's attribute
                parts = name.split('.')
                parent = model.backbone
                for part in parts[:-1]:
                    parent = getattr(parent, part) if hasattr(parent, part) else parent._modules[part]
                setattr(parent, parts[-1], mixout_layer)
    return model

# Apply Mixout to backbone before training starts
model = apply_mixout_to_model(model, p_replace=0.1)

# Keep standard dropout for attention pooling and FFN head
# (already handled by dropout_rate parameter in model definition)

# CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts for SWA exploration cycles
total_epochs = num_epochs
warmup_epochs = max(1, int(0.1 * total_epochs))
cosine_scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=10, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-6
)
warmup_scheduler = LinearLR(optimizer, start_factor=0.1, total_iters=warmup_epochs)
scheduler = SequentialLR(
    optimizer,
    schedulers=[warmup_scheduler, cosine_scheduler],
    milestones=[warmup_epochs],
)

# SWA: collect model snapshots
swa_model_snapshots = []
swa_start_epoch = 30  # Start collecting from epoch 30

# Remove EMA and self-distillation, use standard CE loss only
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    # Step scheduler per epoch
    scheduler.step()

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()

    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,

        self.attn_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=self.num_heads,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Learnable query token for attention pooling
        self.query_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_size))
        # Two-layer feed-forward network
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(768, hidden_size),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.final_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)
        batch_size = hidden_states.size(0)
        # Expand query token for batch
        query = self.query_token.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Create key_padding_mask from attention_mask (True for padding tokens)
        key_padding_mask = ~attention_mask.bool()
        # Multi-head attention pooling
        attn_output, _ = self.attn_pool(
            query=query,
            key=hidden_states,
            value=hidden_states,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )  # attn_output: (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        pooled_attn = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
        # Mean pooling as residual connection
        mean_pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()).sum(dim=1) / \
                      attention_mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).float().clamp(min=1e-9)
        pooled = pooled_attn + mean_pooled  # Residual connection from mean pooling
        # Apply feed-forward network with residual connection
        ffn_out = self.ffn(pooled)
        combined = pooled + ffn_out
        logits = self.final_head(combined)
        return logits

    with torch.no_grad():

            ema_param.data.mul_(decay).add_(param.data, alpha=1 - decay)

# Self-distillation KL loss function
def kl_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, temperature=3.0):
    student_soft = F.log_softmax(student_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    teacher_soft = F.softmax(teacher_logits / temperature, dim=-1)
    return F.kl_div(student_soft, teacher_soft, reduction='batchmean') * (temperature ** 2)

def build_glove_embedding(vocab, embedding_dim=300):
    """Build embedding matrix from GloVe 300d pretrained vectors."""
    print("Loading GloVe embeddings...")
    embedding_dict = {}
    glove_path = "./input/glove.840B.300d.txt"

            parts = line.strip().split()

                continue
            word = " ".join(parts[:-embedding_dim])
            try:
                vector = np.array(parts[-embedding_dim:], dtype=np.float32)
                embedding_dict[word] = vector
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                continue
    vocab_size = len(vocab)
    embedding_matrix = np.random.normal(0, 0.1, (vocab_size, embedding_dim))
    found_count = 0
    for word, idx in vocab.items():
        if word in embedding_dict:
            embedding_matrix[idx] = embedding_dict[word]
            found_count += 1
    print(f"Found {found_count}/{vocab_size} words in GloVe")
    return torch.tensor(embedding_matrix, dtype=torch.float32)

def build_vocab(texts, max_vocab_size=50000):
    from collections import Counter
    word_counts = Counter()
    for text in texts:
        words = str(text).lower().split()
        word_counts.update(words)
    most_common = word_counts.most_common(max_vocab_size - 2)
    vocab = {"<PAD>": 0, "<UNK>": 1}
    for word, _ in most_common:
        vocab[word] = len(vocab)
    return vocab

def tokenize_text(text, vocab, max_length=256):
    words = str(text).lower().split()
